summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) with tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (45 passed). Nothing is committed. Ruff was not run because it is not installed in the shared venv; line lengths were checked by hand. Notes: a custom list walker replaces Graph.items so cycles raise SHACLPathError instead of ValueError; non-Node inputs also raise TypeError; the core SequencePath flattens nested sequences, so nesting is not visible in results.
